title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-sophia-ramirez-2026-03-04
content:
Daily scratchpad - 2026-03-04
Owner: Sophia Ramirez (SDR)

MORN CHECK (before 10am)
- quick CRM triage: new leads + demo requests -> 5 flagged to prioritize
- inbox: triage demo booking confirmations / demo follow-ups (urgent)
- plan: 40 outbound dials, 25 LinkedIn touches, 8 follow-up emails

TOP PRIORITIES
1) Follow up w/ Demo booked last week (Acme Health) - confirm stakeholder list + prep brief
2) Rescue cold response for MegaRetail (re-engage, new ROI stat to share)
3) Qualify two inbound PQLs from hosted-api trial -> route to AE if good fit

CALL LIST (order = priority)
- 9:00 AM - Acme Health (CRM: 00321) - spoke 2/27, demo Wed. Ask: who will own deployment? Need list of compliance reqs. Note: DM = Sarah G. -> bring up Private deployment option.
- 9:40 AM - MegaRetail (CRM: 00488) - interested in latency/cost for search use-case. Sent case study 3/1. Try to book technical call w/ infra lead.
- 10:30 AM - BrightFin (CRM: 00712) - left voicemail 3/2. Ask: update on renewal, decision timeline.
- 11:15 AM - Nimbus Analytics (CRM: 00904) - inbound PQL, trial usage spike. Qualify: model footprint, SLOs, data residency needs.
- 2:00 PM - GreenLoop (CRM: 00661) - follow-up re: Dedicated pricing. Check if finance reviewed seat-based vs committed GPU.
- 3:20 PM - QuickAd (CRM: 01002) - cold outbound (first touch) - value prop: lower per-token cost via batching + quantization recs.

FOLLOW-UPS / EMAILS TO SEND (templates)
- Acme Health follow-up (after call): quick recap + ask for stakeholder emails + suggested agenda for demo (10min prep doc)
- MegaRetail re-engage: 1-line subject: "Latency numbers + benchmarking we ran for retail search" + attach 1-pager + invite infra lead
- Inbound PQL -> Nimbus: "Next steps to qualify trial -> short questionnaire" + propose 30-min tech screen w/ AE/SE

NOTES / QUICK CONVERSATION POINTS
- Emphasize Redwood: dedicated + private options for compliance (good for Acme/BrightFin)
- Cost talk: mention Optimize toolkit and common % savings from batching (15-25%) vs default
- Objection prep: "we already use vendor X" -> call out model/serving economics, rollout/observability + easier fallbacks

OPEN OPS (pipeline actions)
- OPP-4821 (MegaRetail) -> update stage: engaged, add infra contact, set follow-up 3/11
- OPP-4990 (BrightFin renewal) -> create win-back play: pricing concession if commit 6mo

TODOS (today)
- [ ] run MegaRetail benchmark doc + attach to outbound email (target by 11am)
- [ ] book Nimbus technical qualification (propose 3 slots)
- [ ] update SFDC with call notes + next steps for Acme Health
- [ ] 40 dials (block 2 x 90min sessions)
- [ ] sync w/ AE Noah Lee about pipeline hand-offs (quick stand at 4pm)

CADENCE / FOLLOW-UP TIMELINES
- Cold outbound: 3-touch + 2-week window. Ln message on day 3 if no reply.
- Inbound PQL: email within 2 hours, qualify same day if possible, AE intro within 48h.
- Demo follow-ups: send one-pager + 3 suggested next steps within 24h.

LEARNINGS / QUICK RETROSPECT
- Messaging that landed last week: "predictable latency at 99th perc + rollout safeguards" - got attention from platform teams
- KPI to watch: demo->P0 conversion rate this quarter (aim 18%)

RANDOM NOTES / TO SELF
- Ask Priya for updated pricing sheet (dedicated tiers)
- Share MegaRetail benchmark to #sdr-team for feedback before send
- Prep a one-slide tech explainer for Private deployment differences (short, for quick send)

END OF DAY CHECK (EOD)
- update CRM + move completed tasks to done
- send quick status DM to manager (Priya) if any blockers

snippets (copy/paste)
- Cold LinkedIn opener: "Hey <name> — I work with teams building product search that cut per-query cost by ~20% while improving 95th p99 latency. Curious if you own infra/product for search?"
- Quick follow-up email (post-demo): "Thanks for the demo today — attaching the brief and suggested next steps. Open to syncing w/ your infra lead next week?"
